diffs.diff: header pin 5 (SEL): part says gnd, datasheet reading says io
diffs.evidence: SEN5x datasheet Table (pin assignment): '5 SEL Interface select - Connect to GND'; section I2C: 'in order to correctly select I2C as interface, the interface select (SEL) pin must be pulled to GND before or at the same time the sensor is powered up.' The model only supports I2C, so SEL is a strap wired to GND, not a signal driven by the MCU; role 'gnd' gives the correct wiring. The second reading labelled it 'io' only because it is a logic input (abs. max -0.3..5.5 V), not because it should go to a GPIO.
